_description: Age 74, large Traditional ($4.59M) + Taxable ($100k) + modest spending ($108k). RMD's net-of-tax proceeds exceed spending, so no Taxable withdrawal should occur. Regression for over-pull bug that generated phantom federal/state LTCG and NIIT.
_rationale: RMD at 74 = 4,590,000 / 25.5 = 180,000 exactly. As ordinary income, $180k taxed (single filer, FL no state tax) leaves substantially more than the $108k spending need. With RMD-first waterfall, residual spending need is fully absorbed by the RMD itself: withdrawalFromBrokerage = 0, federal/state LTCG = 0, NIIT = 0 (MAGI $180k < $200k single threshold). The leftover RMD (rmdExcess > 0) reinvests into the existing Taxable account.
name: RMD Covers Spending — No Taxable Pull
